fields.name: ClusterId
fields.about: The clusterId if known. This is used to validate metadata fetches prior to broker registration.

fields.name: ReplicaId
fields.about: The broker ID of the follower, of -1 if this request is from a consumer.

fields.name: ReplicaState
fields.about: The state of the replica in the follower.

fields.name: ReplicaId
fields.about: The replica ID of the follower, or -1 if this request is from a consumer.

fields.name: ReplicaEpoch
fields.about: The epoch of this follower, or -1 if not available.

fields.name: MaxWaitMs
fields.about: The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the response.

fields.name: MinBytes
fields.about: The minimum bytes to accumulate in the response.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes to fetch.  See KIP-74 for cases where this limit may not be honored.

fields.name: IsolationLevel
fields.about: This setting controls the visibility of transactional records. Using READ_UNCOMMITTED (isolation_level = 0) makes all records visible. With READ_COMMITTED (isolation_level = 1), non-transactional and COMMITTED transactional records are visible. To be more concrete, READ_COMMITTED returns all data from offsets smaller than the current LSO (last stable offset), and enables the inclusion of the list of aborted transactions in the result, which allows consumers to discard ABORTED transactional records.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.about: The fetch session ID.

fields.name: SessionEpoch
fields.about: The fetch session epoch, which is used for ordering requests in a session.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: The topics to fetch.

fields.name: Topic
fields.about: The name of the topic to fetch.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions to fetch.

fields.name: Partition
fields.about: The partition index.

fields.name: CurrentLeaderEpoch
fields.about: The current leader epoch of the partition.

fields.name: FetchOffset
fields.about: The message offset.

fields.name: LastFetchedEpoch
fields.about: The epoch of the last fetched record or -1 if there is none.

fields.name: LogStartOffset
fields.about: The earliest available offset of the follower replica.  The field is only used when the request is sent by the follower.

fields.name: PartitionMaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes to fetch from this partition.  See KIP-74 for cases where this limit may not be honored.

fields.name: ReplicaDirectoryId
fields.about: The directory id of the follower fetching.

fields.name: HighWatermark
fields.about: The high-watermark known by the replica. -1 if the high-watermark is not known and 9223372036854775807 if the feature is not supported.

fields.name: ForgottenTopicsData
fields.about: In an incremental fetch request, the partitions to remove.

fields.name: Topic
fields.about: The topic name.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions indexes to forget.

fields.name: RackId
fields.about: Rack ID of the consumer making this request.
